title: The Shaman
creator: Marco Kalantari
summaryTr: Savaşın durmadığı bir gelecekte, bir şaman dev bir savaş makinesinin ruhuna ulaşmak için görevlendirilir. Büyü, teknoloji ve aksiyonu bir araya getiren fantastik bir bilim kurgu filmi.
levelNoteTr: Seviye, İngilizce altyazı desteğiyle dinleme için Lantern English tahminidir; resmî CEFR derecesi değildir. Kısa görev konuşmaları ve emirler görsellerle desteklenir; askerî dil, sembolik ifadeler ve farklı aksanlar B2 için ek dikkat gerektirir.
advisoryTr: Savaş, ölüm, kan ve rahatsız edici görüntüler içerir.

captions.text: For thousands of years
Shamans have crossed over to the hereafter, the Netherworld,
to find and heal the souls of people.
But at the dawn of the 23rd century
they turn from healers into mankind's most deadly weapon.
Don't worry. Everything will be fine.
The Shaman is here now.
When I'm dead,
will I be going to the Netherworld?
Yeah.
- We are all going there. - Have you been there?
No.
Not me.
But my master has been there many times.
The Shamans go there to kill the machines, don't they?
Not the machine, but its soul.
Do all machines have a soul?
Yes.
Every object and every being in this world has a soul.
The good ones we can convert. The bad ones we destroy.
Does the Shaman cry sometimes?
No.
The Shaman never cries.
If he ever did, he wouldn't be a Shaman anymore.
Get out of the way!
The enemy battle colossus has taken position on the other side of the plain.
We've thrown everything we have against it.
We've lost nearly 2,000 men so far.
That's all the information we could gather about it.
We're gonna need a mobile shieldfire unit with us.
My Shaman has to come as close as possible to the target
before he transits to the Netherworld.
No shieldfire will hold longer than five to six minutes, max,
against this monster.
That is all I need.
I always wondered what you guys see over there, in the Netherworld.
Must be pretty weird I guess...
It's an A type personality.
Narcissistic.
Probably prone to falling for unmerited flattery.
And tends to over-intellectualize. It also tries too hard to understand
and believes the manipulator has a reason for everything he says or does.
That's how you can trick it.
What is wrong with you?
What?
You worry about me.
I worry about your leaked profile.
If the machine knows about you, it will try to manipulate you.
In all the years I've known you,
I've never heard you talk about your family, your parents.
Is there anything that I should know?
- Can you hear me, Joshua? - I can hear you.
Do not worry.
I love you, Mylord.
I would not want to lose you.
Not to such a pile of bloody scrap.
I am alone.
If there is a god, why is he not showing his face to me?
I would look at him,
and I would smile.
Once I have crossed over, do not fail me.
Yes, Shaman.
The Shaman risks his life for you.
You risk yours for him!
We use Sakakibara, Econ dan Aquarte. 2nd suite, chapter 4. Adagio.
It's too short. The piece is only four minutes long.
That is how I will break it. Trust me.
I always trust you, My Lord.
Let's go.
I must cross over now.
In all the years I've known you,
I've never heard you talk about your family, your parents.
Is there anything that I should know?
Who are you?
You look wonderful.
You are far more beautiful than I expected.
You remind me of someone.
Who is that?
Seduction.
Use charm in order to lower the target's defenses.
She was my friend. I was in love with her, yet she never loved me.
Do you know who I am?
Of course. You are the great battle colossus.
It is a beautiful day today. Isn't it?
Diversion. Target tries to steer the conversation onto another topic.
I wish it could last forever. Time is so short.
Isn't it?
They increased the price for fruits.
But you should never freeze strawberries.
- As they don't like it. - Evasion.
Target gives irrelevant responses in order to evade the manipulation.
I know why you're here.
You are not a soul like the rest of us.
You're a Shaman.
But you will not succeed.
I have seen men like you.
- I have destroyed them. - Good.
Then you know why I am here.
You came here to cheat me.
Hurry up, Joshua!
Oh...
By the way
I saw your file.
I know about your parents.
And the way they died.
It was a beautiful day.
Like today.
Your mother was making dinner. Your father was working from home.
That day
you returned to your hometown.
You went to your parents' house,
you locked all the doors.
Then you set the house on fire.
They looked at you through the window while they burned to death.
That must have been terrible.
No.
- It was an accident! - No.
It was an accident!
No.
That was a choice you made. It was part of your Shaman education
to show your total determination towards your new life.
That was a choice you made.
No, I never chose.
Couldn't you just have told them to leave and disappear?
But you chose to obey the order.
So tell me, Shaman.
Why...
Why?!
Joshua! We are gonna die!
Come on, mate.
Just kill this thing and come back!
There's still a life waiting for you here!
And tends to over-intellectualize. It also tries too hard to understand
and believes the manipulator has a reason for everything he says or does.
That's how you can trick it.
Oh, you're back.
Your favorite dish is ready.
What's so funny?
What is funny?
You believed the story about my parents.
What a simple-minded fool you are.
They are alive.
No.
They are dead. It is in your file.
- You killed them. - You said yourself I cannot be trusted.
We faked my file, then passed it on to your intelligence.
It will only take me one more minute
to finish this here.
You are lying.
Listen...
Do you hear the music?
Perhaps you are familiar with it. It's certainly not my favorite.
But it is four minutes long, which is precisely
why I chose it.
So tell me, machine,
why would I choose a piece that is only four minutes long?
Why?
Why?!
Because I knew it would take me no longer than four minutes
to end you.
You are dead, fucker.
I am your servant. I will do as you say.
Please... Please don’t kill me.
Then turn against your God and your commanders,
and support our troops in the battle.
I killed them.
I killed them!
